statements.label: lem:curve (Lemma 2)
statements.restatement: Irreducible affine curve C, regular f_1..f_m,h, not all f_j constant, sum Re f_j = 1; L=Re h bounded on {all Re f_j>=0}; L>=0 at finite points with all g_j>=0 and some g_j=0. Then L>=0 wherever all g_j>0.

statements.label: lem:safe (Lemma 4)
statements.restatement: If x + C kappa lies in X then Phi_O(Re x) >= min_sigma (P Re x)_sigma for all O in O(4).

statements.label: thm:six (Theorem 5)
statements.restatement: Fixed O in O(4): if the support inequality holds for all nonzero x in X with >=6 contacts, it holds for all x in X (paper Thm 3.6, contrapositive).

statements.label: prop:inventory (Prop 8)
statements.restatement: 214 G-orbits of 6-subsets; 90 with a non-minor generator (distribution 51/35/3/1), 113 exact six-vertex-face orbits; positivity on the 90 families suffices.

statements.label: prop:one-safe (Prop 10)
statements.restatement: Every x in X with contact set containing {0,1,2,3,6,7} satisfies Phi_O(c(x))>=0 for all O in O(4) (hence U(4)); all spectra, repeated eigenvalues via paper Thm C.1, a_i+b_j=0 handled internally.

statements.label: prop:T1-safe (Prop 13)
statements.restatement: Same for {0,1,2,3,6,8} (paper T_2): off the cited degenerations, g7=g9 and c(x) is a nonnegative combination of minor vectors.
